cases.refreshed: Need help with 3D printing or looking for guided, hands-on experience? This session is ideal for beginners seeking practical experience, guided support, and confidence in using 3D printing technology. This is also a good opportunity for those who attended our 3D Design & Printing workshop and now want to try their hands at it. Participants will have the opportunity to print a simple model under supervision. If you do not have a design, you may choose a free design from Thingiverse or a similar site. All designs are printed in a single color of PLA - filament color at the discretion of the program lead. Designs must print in 1 hour 45 minutes - if you're not sure how long your design will take to print, email cz.sjpl@sjlibrary.org. SJPL reserves the right to refuse any print request. All designs must be compatible with the Creality K1C printer and have a print time of under 45 minutes. Final approval of printability will be determined by the program lead. One appointment per month per person.

cases.refreshed: Get into the Holiday spirit by learning some Holiday-inspired songs on the Ukulele! Participants are invited to this fun and educational 2-part series of 1-hour Ukulele lessons. We will learn the basics of reading chords and strumming techniques through familiar songs. This series will take place on 2 dates and will cover the following: November 10: Introduce the parts of the ukulele, how to hold the instrument, and how to read chords. November 17: Combine learned chords with strumming patterns and put it altogether with play songs. No prior music ability required. Ukuleles will be provided to participants. If you have your own ukulele, you may bring it in for this program. Recommended for ages 10 and Up. Free. Registration Required.

cases.refreshed: Every now and then, libraries need a little extra love from the communities they serve. You can volunteer away your library fines at a rate of $20 per hour while helping the library maintain a clean and welcoming environment. Volunteers will help with: Book cover cleaning – Use disinfecting wipes to reinvigorate dingy books. Bookshelves – Dust shelves and organize library materials. Deep cleaning computers – Use disinfecting wipes to disinfect computer mice and mouse pads and compressed air to remove any dust particles or debris. Material inspection – Check books for torn pages, pen marks, etc. This is a perfect opportunity for anyone interested in volunteering away their library fines. Details and Requirements: Must be able to commit to the full session; Anyone under the age of 15 must volunteer alongside a parent/guardian; No experience or special skills necessary; Training and supplies will be provide; Must arrive no later than 10 minutes late. Space is limited.

events.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Competition and Puzzle Swap

cases.refreshed: Are you a dissectologist? Do you love the assembly of jigsaw puzzles? Join our adult puzzle competition! 10 teams 4 people each, 2 hours, 500 pieces, and bragging rights. Each team receives the same 500-piece puzzle. No one gets to see the puzzle until the timer begins. The goal is to be the team that finishes the jigsaw puzzle in the shortest amount of time. If no team is finished at the 2 hour mark, the winning team will be the one with fewest remaining loose pieces. Ages 14+; For puzzle swap, please bring puzzles with no missing pieces. Online Registration required, starting Sunday October 25 at 10 AM. Event capacity is 40 people. You may sign up in groups of four, or as individuals. This event is Sponsored by The Friends of the Cupertino Library. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.
